description: Every observation on the chart, packed without overlaps. Beeswarm, jitter and strip plots for Power BI that keep each point's identity and add the summary on top. Free, and never blocked Three layouts: packed beeswarm, random jitter and strip, deterministic so exports never shimmer. Each point is a record: hover for its ID, value and extra tooltip fields; click to filter the report to it. Summary on top: median bar and mean marker, or a slim box with any whisker rule and quartile definition (Excel / DAX by default). Reference lines: mean, median and up to four percentiles, for all data or per group. Split By, sorting, minimum group size, horizontal layout, cross-highlighting that keeps the whole as a ghost, large-data input, a smart caption, a methods footnote, four themes, keyboard navigation, high contrast, English and Czech. Readers without a licence always see the free chart: no watermark, no broken report. Premium: compare and prove (per-user licence) Significance between groups: Welch t or Mann-Whitney U, Holm or Bonferroni, ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis, letters or brackets. Mean confidence intervals, weights, spec limits (typed or from measures) with Cp to Cpm, small multiples. Premium previews free in Desktop and edit mode. Statistics run offline, golden-tested against scipy and statsmodels; no external calls. Single view or the multi-view? This is the single-view edition…
